meta.name: Cultures of Resistance
meta.description: In 2003, on the eve of the Iraq war, director Iara Lee embarks on a journey to better understand a world increasingly embroiled in conflict. Several years later, after travelling to five continents, Lee encounters growing numbers of people who have committed their lives to change. From Iran to Burma to Palestine and Lebanon,Cultures Of Resistanceexplores how art and creativity can mould with the greater culture of resistance, a part of the battle for peace and justice…
